newsitem.title: USA: Sun Co denies MidAmerica unit for sale.
newsitem.headline: Sun Co denies MidAmerica unit for sale.

text.p: Sun Co's MidAmerican refining and marketing assets are not for sale, although the company would consider a joint venture if the right opportunity presented itself, company spokesman Bud Davis said.
"The division is turning round and it had been for sale two years ago, but we made a very public statement that we had not received any attractive offers and withdrew it," Davis said.
Platts reported on Wednesday that the division, which comprises a 125,000 barrel per day refinery at Toledo, Ohio, filling stations and transportation assets was for sale.
The region broke even in the first quarter of 1997, after a $4.0 million loss a year ago.
"It is improving and we expect it to continue to improve," Davis said. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
